author: Wintergatan
description:
I’m happy to have Onshape supporting the Marble Machine Project,
Try Onshape using the Wintergatan link:
https://onshape.pro/Wintergatan

Get the latest Marble Machine CAD file here:
https://cad.onshape.com/documents/6431f50ab88e26e4984d3fba/w/6ab1127834b4888e3f08529b/e/22a75a293ff3860b31ba3a30?renderMode=0&uiState=69a852d8d8eb195a76dda40d

Regarding collaboration: at the moment, I don’t have any open help topics. From my experience with the MMX project, I’ve learned how important it is to keep help requests clearly defined and focused.
Right now, I need to concentrate on answering the big-picture questions with Hannes. But as soon as we have more detailed problems to solve, Onshape will become the platform where I collaborate with you all. Thank you all and good luck with everything you are doing.
/ Martin
